subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Which open account-scoped channel reload fix should be treated as the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and needs a code fix, but there are multiple open implementation candidates with different proof and branch states, so automation should not start a third competing fix branch.

options.title: Review PR 99312 as canonical
options.body: Treat the current-base, proof-positive generic account-scoped reload PR as the likely landing path and close duplicate reports only after it merges.

options.title: Revive PR 43938
options.body: Ask the original linked PR author to refresh proof and branch state, then use that older closing PR as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Request maintainer-owned replacement
options.body: Close or pause both external branches and have a maintainer sponsor a replacement if neither branch matches the desired reload semantics.

recommendation.title: Review PR 99312 as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat the current-base, proof-positive generic account-scoped reload PR as the likely landing path and close duplicate reports only after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: The local blame/history points to this owner for the current reload planner and handler shape, and the choice is a gateway-core landing decision.
